Output folder path (please select file on SAS Server and not SAS Content):
Output Parquet file name (No need to provide the .parquet extension):

children.text: This custom step utilizes SAS/ACCESS Interface to DuckDB to ingest a source CSV file and convert it into an optimized Parquet file. Open file formats such as Parquet are popular due to the benefits they offer in reduced data footprint and columnar structure. DuckDB provides a popular and performant query processing engine that efficiently handles data ingestion and format conversion.

1. Source CSV file path (file selector, required): select the source CSV file located on the SAS server (filesystem). Note: please select files on the SAS Server and not SAS Content.

2. CSV first line has headers (checkbox, optional): indicate whether the first row of the CSV file contains column headers. Enabled by default.

1. Output folder path (folder selector, required): select the destination folder location on the SAS server (filesystem) where the output Parquet file will be stored. Note: please select folders on the SAS Server and not SAS Content.

2. Output Parquet file name (text field, required): specify the name or prefix for the output Parquet file (no need to provide the .parquet extension).

1. Writing Parquet files using DuckDB: https://duckdb.org/docs/2.0/data/parquet/overview

2. Reading CSV using DuckDB: https://duckdb.org/docs/2.0/guides/file_formats/csv_import

3. SAS/Access Interface to DuckDB: https://go.documentation.sas.com/doc/en/pgmsascdc/v_080/acreldb/p1fekl0cwbnzcmn1026kzjequme4.htm
